title: One scoped task at a time
intro: start records what you are about to do and which paths it may touch. The scope is a claim you will be held to by check and by finish.

scenarios.title: Beginning a task
scenarios.explain: The identity fields — repository, branch, head, worktree — are computed from git and never authored. What you supply is the description, the scope and the profile.

scenarios.title: Starting a second task while one is active
scenarios.explain: One active task per checkout. Two open claims on the same working copy cannot both be enforced, so the second is refused and told what to do first.
